title: Browser form actions, narrow scope (fill, select, check, Enter, text waits and the verifier on admitted pages)
objective: Let an agent fill in an ordinary form on a page the live isolated browser (SG-000108) has already admitted: fill a single-line text field, choose an option of a native select, set a checkbox or radio, press Enter in a single-line field to submit, wait for a text to appear or disappear, and check its own result with the postcondition verifier. orceld stays the sole approval and execution authority; every action is approved one at a time by the person, bound to the page generation, the element and the value. The host and worker halves already exist (BR-02 #472 and #473, BR-07 #471) but are not exposed. Development builds on Windows only; release builds stay unavailable and remote mapping stays off. This is the narrow first scope of the preparation packet docs/orcel/implementation-readiness/prep/SG-000122.md, chosen by the founder on 2026-11-14 (issue #753).

include: Activate the SG-000122 contract only (slice A0). Every slice below needs its own exact-head qualified implementation PR with the review gates and a fresh-context security judge.

Prep packet E1a, fill: promotion of the existing qualified shape browser.dom/fill from model-only to live, on a single-line text field (role textbox or searchbox, an input element; never a textarea or contenteditable) of the committed document of an admitted page. Fields that look secret by type, autocomplete, name or id stay refused (isSecretField).

Prep packet E1b, narrowed: select (one option of a native select element, named by its exact label), check (set a checkbox or radio to a stated state), Enter (the Enter key only, on a single-line text field only) and text waits (wait until a bounded single-line literal text appears or disappears on the committed document, within MAX_WAIT_MS). Hover and every other key of PRESS_KEYS are out.

Prep packet E5, the verifier: the BR-07 postcondition verifier as a read-only tool over the element, text, value, checked-state and URL checks, under its existing caps (MAX_POSTCONDITIONS, MAX_VERIFY_TEXT_BYTES, MAX_VALUE_GUESSES).
Slice A1, host and worker-mode channel: the BR-02 and BR-07 host calls reachable through the host's worker mode, inert (no orceld dispatch, no policy, no tool).

Slice A2, policy and orceld dispatch: the live argument forms in orcel-policy (live_browser.rs), the profile gate, orceld's live dispatch and the broker prompts, with the value shown in the prompt (the rule changes below).
Slice A3, MCP for fill, text waits and the verifier: local-only tools under the browser_structured profile; the exposure profile, discovery, documentation and OAuth scope tables change together (A7).
Slice A4, MCP for select, check and Enter, under the same table rule.
Slice A5, form-control names in observations: observe returns the accessible names of form controls only, bounded and marked untrusted (rule change below).

Slice A6, the Windows native run and closeout: a native Windows journey on a controlled fixture that fills, selects, checks, submits with Enter, waits and verifies through orceld with recorded broker decisions, then canonical closeout.
exclude: E2, uploads (browser.upload/preview and browser.upload/submit stay model-only).
E3, dialog accept (confirm and prompt); the default dismiss is unchanged.
E4, frame observation, same-origin or cross-origin; SG-000108 A4 is untouched.
E6, tabs and popups; popups stay closed as today.
E7, the BR-04 step 1 interactivity flag; the observation contract changes only as slice A5 states.
Every key other than Enter, Enter on a multi-line field (textarea, contenteditable) or on any non-text element, and hover.
Fill of a textarea or contenteditable, of a field that looks secret, or of a value the prompt cannot show in full.
Page text, node values, option labels and the names of anything that is not a form control in any reply.
Release builds (the live path stays only in live-browser-dev builds), remote, tunnel and public profiles, and macOS and Linux (browser launch there waits for SG-000115).
Any new destination, route, listener or relaxation of the SG-000075 navigation rules.

authority_delta.activation: None. This packet authorizes implementing and proving SG-000122; it adds no shape, argument, tool, dependency, listener or authority.
authority_delta.browser: Proposed only (slices A1, A2 and A4): new SOFT-approved browser form actions on the committed document of a page whose origin the lifetime already admitted: fill and Enter on a single-line text field, select one option of a native select, set a checkbox or radio. Development builds (live-browser-dev) on Windows only.
authority_delta.observation: Proposed only (slices A3 and A5): read-only text waits (bounded, per-lifetime capped) and the read-only postcondition verifier, and the accessible names of form controls in observe replies, bounded in length and marked untrusted. No other page text crosses.
authority_delta.mcp: Proposed only (slices A3 and A4): local-only tools under the browser_structured profile for fill, text waits, the verifier, select, check and Enter; exposure, discovery, documentation and OAuth scope tables change together; remote, tunnel and public profiles unchanged.
authority_delta.approval: Unchanged rules: every form action needs its own fresh SOFT approval from the local broker with exact digest binding (page id, store generation, node identity with its role and name, and the value, option label, checked state or key), single use and expiry; the prompt shows the value, and Enter is approved as possibly submitting or sending what the page holds. Waits, the verifier and observation need no approval and create none.
authority_delta.network: None. No new destination, route or listener: the lifetime's single admitted origin and the SG-000075 layers bound where anything a page holds can go.
authority_delta.process: None. The host and worker processes are the existing SG-000108 ones.
authority_delta.release: None. Release builds stay unavailable; the live path exists only in live-browser-dev builds (SG-000108 decision 7).
authority_delta.remote: None. Remote mapping stays disabled for every tool of this grain.
authority_delta.privileged: None. SG-000096 Full User shell remains unarmed.

decisions.question: Open the governed change
decisions.decision: Founder decision of 2026-11-14, given in the Claude Code session and recorded on issue #753. The founder asked Claude to choose the recommended option for each pending decision ("chose the best for me"), then chose the follow-ups directly. Decision 5, as recorded: "activate forms in the browser, narrow first scope: fill, select, check, Enter to submit, text waits, the verifier. One approval per action, bound to page, element and value. Local only, Windows only, development builds only."

decisions.question: Accepted limits
decisions.decision: Recorded on issue #753 as accepted: "a secret typed into an ordinary field isn't detected;" "a page's script can read a filled value and send it to its admitted origin without a submit;" "the effect of pressing Enter can't be known in advance, so the limit is the one admitted destination." This settles the prep packet's open question on secrets: the person is shown the value in the prompt and is told that a value typed into an ordinary field is not classified.

decisions.question: Sequencing
decisions.decision: Recorded on issue #753: "open SG-000122 now, as a fourth open grain beside SG-000096, SG-000127 and SG-000128. SG-000119 (Tauri) opens after forms reach their Windows run."

decisions.question: Rule change: the lawful open-grain set
decisions.decision: The canonical open-grain rule (apps/orcel-mcp/src/openai-plugin.test.ts and p20-architecture.test.ts) allowed SG-000096, SG-000127 and SG-000128 together. It now allows SG-000096, SG-000122, SG-000127 and SG-000128 together, only while CURRENT.md records SG-000122's founder decision, the parallel grains SG-000108, SG-000120, SG-000126 and SG-000129 stay closed, and no other grain beyond SG-000096 exists. This follows the SG-000128 and SG-000129 precedents (issues #515 and #536). SG-000122 is numbered below SG-000126 because the number was reserved for it in the backlog (BR-03, BR-05, BR-06) before later grains were activated; the rule pins the set, not the order.

decisions.question: Rule change: SG-000108 decision 4 (fill model-only)
decisions.decision: SG-000108 decision 4 (docs/security/SG-000108_PRODUCT_CALLER.md; orceld profile_gate.rs and orcel-browser-host exposure.rs) holds browser.dom/fill model-only. For this grain only, it is amended: browser.dom/fill may become a live shape under browser_structured, on a single-line text field of an admitted page, in live-browser-dev builds on Windows, with a fresh SOFT approval whose prompt shows the value. The value must be shown in full: one that is longer than the prompt shows in full (a bound fixed in A2, at most 1024 bytes) or that holds a control character is refused, never truncated. The uploads, browser.profile/status, browser.destination/validate and browser.navigation/preview stay model-only as decision 4 says. SG-000108 A13 (every live tool is one of the twelve SG-000079 shapes) is amended for this grain in the same way: the live shapes of the next decision are admitted beside the twelve, and A7 (the four tables agree mechanically, remote mapping disabled) applies to each.

decisions.question: Rule change: names leaving the isolated browser
decisions.decision: SG-000108's rule that names never leave the isolated browser (orceld live_dispatch.rs: "names and values never leave the isolated browser; nodes carry identities and keyed digests only"; docs/security/SG-000108_PRODUCT_CALLER.md slice 3c) is amended for the accessible names of form controls only (roles textbox, searchbox, combobox, listbox, checkbox and radio on an input or select element of the main frame's committed document). Each name is bounded (at most 256 bytes, cut on a character boundary and marked as cut), control characters are replaced, the reply marks every name as untrusted page content that grants nothing, and secret-looking fields are named but never valued. Values, page text, option labels and the names of every other node keep the rule unchanged. A name is never authority: actions still bind node identities, and the approval binds the role and name the host itself observed.

decisions.question: Rule change: the closed-grain press and select denials
decisions.status: RECORDED (before implementation; no code change in A0)
decisions.decision: The closed-grain pins that deny ("browser.dom", "press") and ("browser.dom", "select") (DENIED_BROWSER_SHAPES in crates/orcel-provider-browser/src/lib.rs, and the STRONG-mapping denial test in crates/orcel-policy/src/sg000024.rs) are not amended; they stay byte for byte, and those two shapes stay denied and STRONG on the model-only path. The live shapes of this grain use non-colliding names: browser.dom/fill (the existing qualified shape, promoted), browser.form/select, browser.form/check, browser.form/enter, browser.wait/text and browser.verify/check. Under the existing prefix rule (is_denied_browser_shape) every browser.form, browser.wait and browser.verify shape stays denied and STRONG on the model-only path; the new names are reachable only through orceld's profile gate (LIVE_BROWSER_SHAPES), the live argument forms in live_browser.rs and the live dispatch. A2 adds a test that the closed-grain pins still deny the two dom shapes and that no live name collides with DENIED_BROWSER_SHAPES. A later rename needs a recorded amendment of this spec.

decisions.question: Rule change: a cap on distinct awaited texts
decisions.decision: A text wait answers whether a chosen text is on the page, so it is a guessing oracle for page text that observation never returns, as the verifier's value check is for values (verify.rs, MAX_VALUE_GUESSES). Each browser lifetime therefore admits at most 16 distinct awaited texts across text waits and the verifier's text checks together, counted by the host on the exact text; repeating a text already counted is free; beyond the cap a new text is refused with a typed error and the page is not probed. The existing per-wait bounds stay: non-empty, at most MAX_VERIFY_TEXT_BYTES, no control character, at most MAX_WAIT_MS, and the committed document only. MAX_VALUE_GUESSES is unchanged.

decisions.question: Rule change: Enter only, single-line fields only, where and in which builds
decisions.decision: The live press is Enter only: today's host press accepts any key of PRESS_KEYS on any element and refuses Enter only in a multi-line field, so the live form adds new checks: the key is exactly Enter and the target is a single-line text field (an input of a text-like type with role textbox or searchbox), else refused before any worker frame. Enter is approved as possibly submitting or sending what the page holds; any origin the prompt shows is an unbound snapshot, and enforcement is the route rule (the lifetime's one admitted destination). Every tool of this grain is Windows-only (macOS and Linux launch stays refused until SG-000115), exists only in live-browser-dev development builds (release builds answer ProviderUnavailable), and is local-only: remote mapping stays off and no remote, tunnel or public profile lists it.

decisions.question: Uploads, dialogs, frames, tabs and the interactivity flag in this grain
decisions.decision: Not needed for a form on one admitted page. E2 is egress, E3 answers page dialogs, E4 and E6 relax SG-000108 A4, E7 changes the observation contract; each needs its own decision.

invariants: orceld remains the sole approval and execution authority; the MCP edge and clients only forward requests.

Every fill, select, check and Enter needs its own fresh SOFT approval bound to the page id, store generation, node identity (role and name as the host observed them) and the value, option label, checked state or key; approvals are single use and expire; a stale page, generation or element is refused, never retargeted.
The prompt shows the value of a fill in full; a value it cannot show in full is refused.
Fields that look secret by type, autocomplete, name or id are never filled and never read.
Navigation, redirects, frames and popups obey SG-000075 and SG-000108 A4 unchanged; the lifetime's single admitted origin is the only destination anything a page holds can reach.
Observation returns node identities, roles and keyed digests, plus the bounded, untrusted-marked accessible names of form controls only; no value, page text or option label crosses.
At most 16 distinct awaited texts per lifetime across waits and verifier text checks; at most MAX_VALUE_GUESSES distinct values per field.
The closed-grain DENIED_BROWSER_SHAPES and sg000024 pins are unchanged; the live names never collide with them.
Windows only, live-browser-dev builds only, local only; release builds and remote mapping stay unavailable.
acceptance: Activation (A0): this spec, CURRENT.md's record of the founder decision and the open-grain pins land together; no shape, argument, tool, policy or dispatch changes.

Policy tests (A2): each live form accepts exactly its fields; caller selectors and every AUTHORITY_FIELDS field are refused; a fill value over the shown bound or with a control character is refused; a press key other than Enter is refused; the closed-grain pins still deny browser.dom/press and browser.dom/select and no live name collides with them.
Approval tests (A2): an approval replayed on another page, generation, element, value, option, state or key is refused; a fill prompt shows the value; an approval is single use.

Host and dispatch tests (A1, A2): Enter on a textarea, contenteditable or non-text element is refused before any worker frame; a secret-looking field is refused; the 17th distinct awaited text in a lifetime is refused without probing; a stale page fails closed.
Observation tests (A5): only form controls carry names; each name is bounded, cut and marked; values, page text and option labels never appear in a reply.

Exposure tests (A3, A4): each tool is in the exposure profile, discovery, documentation and OAuth scope tables together or in none (A7); remote, tunnel and public profiles list none; release builds answer ProviderUnavailable.

Native Windows run (A6): a controlled fixture form is filled, selected, checked, submitted with Enter, waited on and verified through orceld with recorded broker decisions; the SG-000108 native suite still passes.
Exact-head CI (Windows, macOS and Linux legs), Review Gates (Jev Semantic Review, Alibaba OpenCodeReview delegation) and a fresh-context security judge pass on each slice.

review.alibaba_open_code_review: delegation mode per standing founder decision (2026-10-10) with manual review of excluded files
review.security_review: fresh-context security judge on every slice and on closeout; d1-local advisory only

successor_requirements.deferred_slices: Uploads (E2), dialog accept (E3), frame observation (E4), tabs and popups (E6), the interactivity flag (E7), other keys and hover each need their own founder decision.
successor_requirements.release_builds: The live browser in release builds is SG-000127 slice 7's decision; this grain does not change it.
successor_requirements.macos_linux: Browser launch on macOS and Linux waits for SG-000115.
successor_requirements.sg_000119: SG-000119 (Tauri) opens after this grain's Windows run (founder sequencing, #753).

activation_note: No shape, argument, tool, dependency, policy, dispatch or authority change in this activation packet. Separate implementation PRs must qualify their exact heads; activation CI alone proves nothing about form actions.
done_when: On Windows, in a development build, an agent through the local MCP edge fills, selects, checks, submits with Enter, waits for a text and verifies the result on an admitted page, each action approved by the person in orceld's broker with the value shown, every replay, stale target, secret field, non-Enter key, multi-line Enter and over-cap wait refused, and remote, release and the deferred slices still absent.
